quote.text: Determine never to be idle. No person will have occasion to complain of the want of time, who never loses any. It is wonderful how much may be done, if we are always doing.

cards.title: Volunteering & Side Quests Since Leaving Banking

segments.text: As a member the national nonprofit Guitars Over Guns' Jr. BoD's Strategic Initiatives Committee, I have produced deliverables to help professionalize and scale their fundraising function:

Fundraising dashboard: Developed a standardized dashboard to provide increased and organized visibility into GOGO's fundraising data, including realized donations and future opportunities by location, donor type, and campaign over time.

quote.text: We've done so much projections on the budgeting based off of guesswork. And this is like, okay, we can really dial it in... This is really pretty phenomenal to look at.

segments.text: DevOps process mapping & gap identification: Conducted extensive discovery across GOGO's data infrastructure, CRM, fundraising technology, and grants operations to comprehensively document and map existing advancement workflows and identify process gaps, automatable manual processes, and areas for improvement. Delivered to the incoming Chief Advancement Officer to assist in improving processes and developing national SOPs.

quote.text: holy sh*t! These are amazing. All of this is pointing toward the very SOPs that I know [incoming CAO] wants to focus on. Blown away.

segments.text: Conducted extensive process discovery and workflow mapping to identify areas for efficiency and automation:
Vibe coded (Cursor) an inventory intake tool that automates manual excel actions when receiving new book shipments and tracking them in the inventory system.
Wanted to make a slick site to tell people more about my work and who I am as a person. Had a lot of fun making this with Cursor.
Planned my group's L&T M&A conference and implemented new meeting scheduling software that increased the number of CEO-to-investor meetings by 10x YoY.
Sellside: Sale of Horizon Air Freight to GHK Capital Partners

My first time as an analyst owning the end-to-end deal execution. Built the CIM, management presentation, and projections model. I prepped management for >60 investor meetings and quarterbacked intensive diligence.

In the final stages, a lead buyer challenged management's growth assumptions. Over a weekend, I worked round the clock with the C-suite to build a granular, customer sub-account-level price/volume model and personally presented it to the managing partner of the $5B PE fund, answering heated live Q&A. The analysis addressed their concerns and resulted in an updated offer that included a $50M earnout above the original bid.
Buyside: Mobico North American School Bus Acquired by I Squared Capital

I ran point on this buyside M&A deal, operating much like a Chief of Staff to our client. I was the main intermediary between our internal groups, our client's team, their 12 teams of consultants, six lenders, and the sellside banks. I was also in charge of special projects like valuation models, market research, and IC board decks.

The volume and complexity of projects and information flow was extreme, and I quarterbacked weekly all-hands standups and daily workstream summaries to keep everyone aligned and on track and the deal successfully closed for ~$600m.

content.attribution: — My MD during my first performance review
